Patna Metro Station Inside Tour | andar kya chal raha hai?
Namaskar doston,
Aaj ki is vidiyo men main aapko Patna Metro Station ka Inside Tour dikhane vala hun. is vidiyo men aap dekhenge Patna Metro ki Ground Reality, steshan ka nirman kary, aaspas ka mahaul aur bhavishy men bihar ke lie yah projekt kitna mahatvapurn hone vala hai.
Agar aap patna, bihar ya Patna Metro Project men ruchi rakhte hain, to yah vidiyo aapke lie hai.
Location: Patna, Bihar
